smoothing.what: the two inner edges and the bank's width; the outer edges are the built ones, unmoved

heights.rows: planar across: a line rides on the chord of its own road's two edges
heights.datum: the built west edge: its place and height are kept; the measured shape across the road is laid onto it

datum_shift_m._doc: built west edge minus the lidar there: how far every height here stands off the lidar

edges._doc: offsets from the OLD line per station of the two roads, + = west: what the scene rows are built to (the mainline row = sb_west, its line, sb_east; the piece row = nb_west, its line, nb_east)
edges._doc_y: SURFACE heights of the same four edges (a row is west edge, line + LIFT, east edge: tilted, not flat)

rows._doc: the SCENE's rows, engine xyz (x east, y up = the SURFACE, z north). Two roads, v = NOSE..TAIL: the mainline's row is sb_west (ROAD's own west vertex, unmoved), sb_line, sb_east; the piece's row is nb_west, nb_line, nb_east (nb_east = where ROAD's east vertex stood, raised). Forks, v = A0+1..NOSE-1 and TAIL+1..A1-1: ROAD's three vertices keep their place and take fork_y (west, centre, east): the tilt easing in from the flat outer row.

frame._doc: the BUILT line around the zone, per centreline vertex: its point (engine x, y, z), its left normal (nx, nz: + = west on College), half the built width and the station. Scene vertices are told apart by station and offset in THIS frame (the built objects were swept in it).

lap_zone._doc: the Speedway lap through the zone, one point per mainline station (south join, the piece, north join)
